judge: thinking judge with one-sentence reason (run_variants.judge_with_reason), unchanged; the exact verifier only scores
execution: Arms run sequentially in arm_order, each alone on the fleet via inkling/arms.py (fresh admission with the shim sha and mem fraction below, prefix-cache flush, server counters, idle wait, GPU energy). Watchdog inkling/watch.sh; MemAvailable logged every 60 s.
resume_rule: If an arm stops on an infrastructure fault (runner stop flag, worker or judge infra failure, node fault), the fault is fixed and the same arm is continued with arms.py --resume-from (skips its cases that finished without infra faults; reruns the others with the same seeds) and documented as an amendment. Server tokens, wall and energy of an arm are then the sums over its segments (wasted work of the stopped segment included and reported separately). Never a silent restart; no case is dropped.
exclusions: None. All 96 cases of each arm count.

serving.launch: inkling/serve.sh, MEM=0.75 since 2026-11-21 16:25 Europe/Warsaw (KV ~1.08M tokens per node)
serving.adapter: inkling/shim.py (vLLM dialect; client disconnects close the upstream stream and count as shim:client_cancels)

concurrency_note: Both arms: at most 4 agents in flight per case (cap 12), 20 cases at once, per-endpoint slot cap 20 (agents and judges) <= 25 per node. Each arm runs alone.
generator: make_arithmetic_hard.py --seed 2026112419 --protocol arithmetic-hard-v19 --output datasets/arithmetic-hard-v19 (after this plan is committed and pushed); same rules as hard-v5..v18
question: Generic artifact relay inside the swarm (owner rule: generic only). The dev screens found RELAY 4 vs REPLACE 0 rescues (hard-v18, 14 abstentions) [replication on hard-v16 esc_none reported in the night summary]. G = roll12cancel (default); RL = roll12relay: identical, but each escalation agent (slot >= 4) receives the fixed generic sentence of relay.py plus the last 12,000 characters of one failed agent of the same case, chosen by seeded uniform sampling among agents that already ended without an accepted plan and were not yet handed over (if none with a non-empty artifact is left, an already handed-over one may be reused; if none at all, no extra text).
pairing: Same tasks, seeds, agent base seeds (1000*seed + 19400 + slot), initial node placement and judge base seeds; slots 0-3 identical. Escalation agents differ by the relayed text; sampling seeds hash the prompt; escalation slots take the node freed first.

primary_outcomes.accuracy: Solved and wrong per arm; paired exact sign test.
primary_outcomes.mechanism: Cases answered by escalation agents and by relayed agents per arm.
primary_outcomes.cost: Server generation and prompt/prefill tokens per case, arm wall, GPU Wh per solved (reported).

decision_rule: RL (roll12relay) replaces G (roll12cancel) as the arithmetic default if RL has 0 wrong, RL solved >= G solved, and RL answers at least as many cases through escalation agents as G. Cost and wall are reported, not gated (owner priority: quality).
baseline_note: Defaults: arithmetic roll12cancel (generic, no hints) since swarm-generic-hard18-v1; coding R2; worker transport retry and judge retry.
